scope: Compare prior recommendations with publicly observable LadhaQuest product claims and pages
important_caveat: Search results show product claims and marketing copy, but the live application could not be rendered for functional testing. Therefore, implementation should be verified through account-level testing, API inspection, database/schema review, and user flows before declaring a feature complete.

recommendation_audit.recommendation: Structured recipe schema and advanced search
recommendation_audit.public_evidence: Recipe index supports country, region, meal type, ingredient, diet, time, and difficulty filters; recipe pages exist for country-specific dishes.
execution_guideline: Audit every recipe for required fields: title, slug, country, region, cuisine, meal type, diet tags, allergens, servings, prep/cook/total time, difficulty, equipment, ingredients, steps, nutrition, cost, local names, substitutions, provenance, media, ratings, and related recipes.
Create a canonical recipe schema and migration plan; reject recipes missing critical fields from premium search and AI planning.
Implement JSON-LD Recipe structured data on every public recipe page.
Build PostgreSQL full-text search plus Typesense/Meilisearch for fast filtering and typo tolerance.
Add ingredient-level search using recipe_ingredients joins and normalized ingredient IDs.
Add natural-language query parsing for budget, time, diet, country, cuisine, and available ingredients.
Track search impressions, zero-result rate, click-through rate, and search-to-recipe-view conversion.

recommendation_audit.recommendation: African ingredient graph and local-name extraction
recommendation_audit.public_evidence: LadhaQuest publicly claims local ingredient names and substitutions.
execution_guideline: Create canonical ingredients, ingredient_aliases, substitutions, ingredient_availability, and ingredient_sources tables.
Seed the graph with 1,000 high-frequency African ingredients before expanding.
Run a Wikidata extraction pipeline using SPARQL for discovery and wbgetentities for labels, aliases, descriptions, and claims.
Extract names in English, Swahili, Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo, Amharic, Zulu, Xhosa, French, Arabic, and Portuguese.
Store all Wikidata-derived aliases as review_status='proposed' and confidence below curated records.
Require culinary editors to approve local names, country mappings, and substitutions.
Maintain source, license, imported_at, confidence, review_status, reviewer, and last_reviewed on every record.
Build an admin review queue with approve, reject, edit, merge, and flag-duplicate actions.

recommendation_audit.public_evidence: LadhaQuest advertises substitutions, market-aware substitutions, and advanced batch substitutions.
execution_guideline: Implement retrieval in three layers: curated substitutions, functional equivalents, and semantic candidates.
Apply hard filters before ranking: allergens, dietary restrictions, safety flags, availability, and cooking-method compatibility.
Score candidates using curated confidence, flavor similarity, texture similarity, availability, budget fit, dietary compatibility, and user preference.
Return direct, functional, and emergency substitutions separately so users understand tradeoffs.
Use the LLM only to explain the selected substitute and adjust quantity, liquid, seasoning, or cook time.
Pass an allowlist of candidate ingredient IDs to the LLM; never allow it to invent an ingredient ID or final ranking.
Show confidence, flavor impact, texture impact, cooking adjustments, and warnings in the UI.
Track acceptance, rejection, recipe completion, and 'this worked / did not work' feedback to improve rankings.

recommendation_audit.public_evidence: LadhaQuest advertises meal planning, AI meal plans, budget optimization, and household collaboration.
execution_guideline: Create meal_plans, planned_meals, grocery_lists, grocery_list_items, pantry_items, and household_members tables.
Let users set household size, days, meals per day, budget, diet, allergies, cuisine preferences, and pantry inventory.
Generate plans using recipe constraints, nutrition targets, ingredient overlap, seasonal availability, and budget limits.
Aggregate ingredients across planned meals, normalize units, combine duplicates, and group by supermarket aisle or market section.
Allow users to mark pantry items as owned and exclude them from the shopping list.
Support portion scaling, unit conversion, leftovers, and meal swaps.
Cache generated plans and allow offline access to the active plan.

recommendation_audit.public_evidence: LadhaQuest advertises an AI-powered pantry system and smart pantry matching.
execution_guideline: Build pantry_items with ingredient_id, quantity, unit, purchase_date, expiry_date, location, confidence, and source.
Support manual entry, barcode scan, receipt OCR, and optional photo recognition.
Use the substitution engine to recommend recipes based on available ingredients.
Prioritize expiring items and reduce food waste through 'use it up' suggestions.
Never automatically publish uncertain AI-recognized items; require user confirmation.
Provide clear privacy controls, deletion, and data-export options.

recommendation_audit.public_evidence: LadhaQuest advertises offline cook mode and unlimited offline packs.
execution_guideline: Implement a PWA with service-worker caching for app shell, saved recipes, active meal plans, and recently viewed recipes.
Use IndexedDB for offline recipe and plan storage; use Cache Storage for static assets and selected media.
Provide explicit offline-pack downloads with storage estimates and deletion controls.
Compress images, lazy-load media, and offer a low-data image mode.
Sync saved recipes, pantry changes, and meal-plan edits when connectivity returns.
Test on low-end Android devices, slow 3G, intermittent connectivity, and background sync.

recommendation_audit.public_evidence: Install page mentions early access to creator tools; no broad public evidence of a full creator publishing, moderation, monetization, or community system.
execution_guideline: Build creator profiles with bio, country, specialties, verified badge, recipes, followers, and contact controls.
Create a recipe submission workflow with draft, review, approved, rejected, and published states.
Add moderation for copyright, plagiarism, food safety, cultural accuracy, spam, and inappropriate content.
Require source attribution and permission documentation for family or third-party recipes.
Add creator analytics: views, saves, completion rate, ratings, follower growth, and revenue.
Launch monetization through premium classes, affiliate ingredient bundles, brand collaborations, and creator subscriptions.
Add community reviews, photos, cook notes, regional variants, and family-story preservation.

recommendation_audit.public_evidence: No clear public evidence of retailer integrations, ingredient bundles, delivery, price comparison, or marketplace checkout.
execution_guideline: Start with affiliate links and ingredient bundles rather than building a full marketplace.
Create products, retailers, offers, prices, availability, and price_history tables.
Map recipe ingredients to retailer products with confidence and fallback options.
Show price freshness, retailer name, availability status, and substitution alternatives.
Integrate local payment methods, including mobile money where available.
Partner with one retailer or delivery provider per launch market before scaling.
Clearly disclose affiliate and sponsored placements.
Measure recipe-to-cart conversion, bundle attach rate, repeat purchase rate, and revenue per active user.

recommendation_audit.public_evidence: Recipe index includes diet filters; nutrition completeness is not publicly confirmed.
execution_guideline: Store nutrition per 100 g and per serving, with source, confidence, and calculation method.
Use FAO/national African food-composition tables for local foods and USDA FoodData Central for global baseline coverage.
Calculate recipe nutrition from ingredient quantities, accounting for yield loss and preparation method where possible.
Display allergens, dietary tags, and food-safety warnings prominently.
Avoid medical claims; label nutrition as estimates and link to sources.
Require dietitian or nutrition-reviewer approval for health-oriented collections.
Implement a consistent event taxonomy: search, recipe_view, save, share, substitution_view, substitution_accept, plan_create, list_create, pantry_update, checkout_start, purchase, and creator_submit.
Build dashboards for acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, content quality, AI quality, and revenue.
Run A/B tests on search ranking, recipe-page layout, substitution presentation, meal-plan onboarding, and pricing.
Set weekly quality reviews for zero-result searches, incorrect substitutions, broken recipes, and user reports.
Establish an incident process for bad nutrition, allergen, food-safety, or cultural-accuracy errors.

cursor_ai_implementation.instruction: Use this audit as the implementation backlog for LadhaQuest. First verify existing functionality, then close the highest-risk data and AI-quality gaps before expanding commerce.
